summary.text: Tom Woods is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 4 who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Ellen Cuff as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Woods has owned businesses and worked as a farmer.
Woods assumed office on November 23, 2022, and defeated Kenny Smith in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Wildlife, Appropriations, Energy, and Retirement and Insurance committees and the Joint Appropriations and Budget Committee.
